game_manager_service.description: Android 12+ Game Dashboard and Game Interventions subsystem allowing resolution downscaling, target FPS capping, and performance mode overrides without root privileges.

commands.mechanism: Forces the system to switch the target game into PERFORMANCE game mode (mode 2), triggering high-performance scheduler affinity and higher GPU thermal ceilings.
Applies hardware buffer downscaling (e.g. 0.7, 0.75, 0.8) and FPS targets (60, 90, 120). Halves the pixel shading fill-rate required by the GPU, completely eliminating frame drops in heavy titles.
Inspects currently available and active game modes for an installed application.
Dumps current downscale ratio, target FPS, and intervention configurations.
Resets game mode interventions back to OEM system defaults.

device_config_fallback.mechanism: Bypasses manifest restrictions for apps not declaring category=game, forcing the GameModeConfiguration engine to intercept their rendering pipelines.

package_manager_and_art_compiler.description: Direct manipulation of dex2oat Ahead-Of-Time native compilation and system cache trim routines via ADB shell.

commands.mechanism: Executes full Ahead-Of-Time (AOT) machine code compilation on all DEX methods of the target package. Completely eliminates JIT compiler background threads and eliminates runtime compilation hitches during gameplay.
commands.speed_benefit: Zero JIT pauses, 15-25% faster cold start, deterministic frame rendering.

commands.mechanism: Pre-compiles XML layout files directly into executable Java bytecode, bypassing XmlPullParser runtime XML parsing and eliminating UI inflation stutter.
commands.speed_benefit: Sub-millisecond view inflation on high-complexity view hierarchies.

commands.mechanism: Forces PackageManager to prune cached app directories across internal storage safely without violating sandbox permissions.
commands.example: cmd package trim-caches 4294967296 (Trims up to 4GB of obsolete cache files instantly).

commands.mechanism: Verifies and aligns secondary DEX and dynamic split-code files with the main execution profile.
Manually triggers the background DEX optimization job that Android normally defers to overnight idle charging.

app_ops_service.description: Silent background suppression of battery-draining and CPU-hogging applications (social media, telemetry SDKs) without root.

commands.mechanism: Revokes permission for the app to execute background services or thread workers when user leaves the app.
Prevents any auxiliary or broadcast receiver executions in the background.
Blocks app from acquiring PowerManager WakeLocks, preventing it from keeping CPU cores awake during screen-off.
Prevents the app from spawning sticky foreground services with persistent notifications.
Denies overlay permissions, preventing overlay injection and unwanted window compositing.

app_hibernation_service.description: Android 12+ framework feature that places inactive or memory-heavy apps into cold hibernation state.

commands.mechanism: Instantly places the package into user-level hibernation. OS terminates running processes, clears ephemeral runtime caches, and suspends alarms until next explicit user launch.
Forces global multi-user level hibernation on bloatware.
Queries whether a package is actively hibernating.

window_manager_and_surfaceflinger.description: Eliminates GPU-intensive Gaussian real-time blurs, removes transition animations, and forces ANGLE Vulkan translation layer via Shell settings.

commands.mechanism: Globally disables real-time background blur compositing on Android 12+, saving massive GPU compute cycles and eliminating notification shade drop stutter.
Persistent global flag disabling window blurs across system UI.
Zeroes window opening/closing animations for instant response.
Zeroes activity transition delays.
Zeroes ObjectAnimator and ValueAnimator durations.
Enforces ANGLE (Almost Native Graphics Layer Engine) backed by Vulkan API for all GLES apps without root.
Specifies high-priority target packages for ANGLE Vulkan redirection.
Forces ANGLE selection for target package.
Locks display refresh rate upper ceiling to 120Hz.
Locks display refresh rate lower floor to 120Hz, preventing dynamic downclocking.

device_config_and_phenotype.description: Manipulating system-level runtime flags and freezing Google Play Services Phenotype sync to prevent settings from being reverted remotely.

commands.mechanism: CRITICAL: Freezes remote Phenotype synchronization from Google Play Services, ensuring that custom DeviceConfig tweaks persist indefinitely across reboots.
Overrides brightness throttling, maintaining 120Hz under bright sunlight.
Overrides brightness throttling, maintaining 120Hz in low light.

commands.command: cmd device_config put activity_manager_native_boot use_freezer true
commands.mechanism: Enables Linux cgroup v2 background app freezer without root.
Shortens freeze debounce delay from 10s to 1s.

commands.command: cmd device_config put statsd active false
commands.mechanism: Suspends statsd atom pulling engine.

power_and_activity_manager.description: Sustained performance mode locks and idle memory reclaim.

commands.mechanism: Requests the SoC Power HAL to enter sustained fixed performance mode, preventing aggressive CPU frequency throttling during prolonged gaming sessions.
Triggers immediate system-wide idle maintenance, freeing trimmed memory, compacting ART heap, and cleaning stale binder references.
Forces deep Doze state on inactive background apps immediately.
